sourceQuestions.sourceText: Say each word, then write the missing sounds. tr__ (it grows in the garden), h__ (you wear it on your head), c__ (you wear it when it is cold), s__ (you wear it on your foot)
Circle the words with the oa sound. boat pop goat hat road loaf say

Could it really happen? Write R for real or F for fantasy. a A boy plays football in the park. b A purple monster lives in the washing machine. c There are mountains made of ice cream. d Mum puts the clothes in the washing machine.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a R • b F • c F • d R

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write this sentence again with a capital letter and a full stop. the cat sat on the mat
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: The cat sat on the mat.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Put the words in the right order to make a sentence. jumped Aqsa cloud onto the
Write beginning, middle or end. a Aqsa wakes up in her own bed. b Aqsa falls into the washing machine. c The mother plopper cropper chases Aqsa.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a end • b beginning • c middle

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Make each word mean "more than one". Write it in the right box. cat box dish dog bus bird (add s / add es)
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: add s: cats, dogs, birds • add es: boxes, dishes, buses

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Draw your own fantasy creature. Give it a name, and write one sentence about it. Remember the capital letter and the full stop!
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Any creature that could not be real, with a name. The sentence must start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: A fantasy story is about things that ( happen every day ) ( could not happen in real life ) ( happened to me yesterday )
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: could not happen in real life

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Aqsa fell into the ( bath ) ( fridge ) ( washing machine )
A sentence ends with a ( full stop ) ( capital letter ) ( comma )
More than one fox is ( foxs ) ( foxes ) ( fox )
The main character in Aqsa's Adventures is ( the green cloud ) ( Mum ) ( Aqsa )
